newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Family, including two children, shot in Bogota.
newsitem.headline: Family, including two children, shot in Bogota.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot and killed five family members, two of them small children aged three and six, in a working-class district of Bogota, authorities said on Sunday.

Col. Milton Alberto Melo, deputy commander of the Metropolitan Police, said the attack occurred late on Saturday and the motive was believed to be a "settling of accounts" with two of the victims, both men in their early 20s.
All five of the victims, including a 44-year-old, suffered multiple gunshot wounds while inside their small house in the Guacmayas district of the capital.
